Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Copper accounts for the largest increase in your cost explanation; it sounds like covering that exposure is central to sustaining our longstanding partnership. We want a fair adjustment that supports that continuity and gives both sides commercial predictability. How can we balance price and payment timing so the arrangement works sustainably for both of us?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have incorporated the verified decrease in steel prices and your positive volume forecast into our calculation. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Extending payment terms to 90 days increases our financing costs and would require a higher unit price. 

Our current offer is a price of €371.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. As an alternative, to provide you with the most competitive rate, we propose returning to 30-day payment terms at a reduced price of €367.43, which represents an option at a price of €367.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel at our standard terms. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
